passages.vernacular: 確實長話短講係,我服侍猶太人,有個願望,如我父親將講明嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實長話短說是,我服侍猶太人,有個願望,如我父親將說明的。

passages.title: Old Gobbo 老高波
passages.original: His master and he (saving your worship’s reverence) are scarce cater-cousins.
passages.vernacular: 佢同佢嘅主人(恕閣下失禮)幾乎唔係知己。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他和他的主人(恕閣下失禮)幾乎不是知己。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: To be brief, the very truth is that the Jew, having done me wrong, doth cause me, as my father, being I hope an old man, shall frutify unto you.
passages.vernacular: 簡單講,實情係,猶太人冤枉咗我,使我,如我父親,我希望係個老人,將向您轉達嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 簡單說,實情是,猶太人冤枉了我,使我,如我父親,我希望是個老人,將向您轉達的。

passages.title: Old Gobbo 老高波
passages.original: I have here a dish of doves that I would bestow upon your worship, and my suit is—
passages.vernacular: 我呢度有一碟鴿子要獻畀閣下,我嘅請求係——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我這裡有一碟鴿子要獻給閣下,我的請求是——

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: In very brief, the suit is impertinent to myself, as your worship shall know by this honest old man, and though I say it, though old man, yet poor man, my father.
passages.vernacular: 好簡短,呢請求同我自己不相干,閣下將從呢位誠實老人嗰度得知,雖然係我講嘅,雖然係老人,卻係窮人,我嘅父親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常簡短,這請求與我自己不相干,閣下將從這位誠實老人那裡得知,雖然是我說的,雖然是老人,卻是窮人,我的父親。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: One speak for both.
passages.vernacular: 一個人講兩個人嘅話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個人說兩個人的話。

passages.original: What would you?
passages.vernacular: 你要乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要什麼?

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Serve you, sir.
passages.vernacular: 服侍你,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 服侍你,先生。

passages.title: Old Gobbo 老高波
passages.original: That is the very defect of the matter, sir.
passages.vernacular: 呢正是呢事嘅缺點,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這正是這事的缺點,先生。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: I know thee well; thou hast obtain’d thy suit.
passages.vernacular: 我好了解你;你嘅請求已得到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很了解你;你的請求已得到。

passages.original: Shylock thy master spoke with me this day, And hath preferr’d thee, if it be preferment To leave a rich Jew’s service to become The follower of so poor a gentleman.
passages.vernacular: 夏洛克你主人今日跟我談過,已升遷咗你,如果離開富猶太人嘅服務,去做咁樣一位窮紳士嘅跟隨者算得上升遷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夏洛克你主人今天跟我談過,已升遷了你,如果離開富猶太人的服務,去做這樣一位窮紳士的跟隨者算得上升遷。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: The old proverb is very well parted between my master Shylock and you, sir:
passages.vernacular: 老諺語喺我主人夏洛克同你之間分得好好:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 老諺語在我主人夏洛克和你之間分得很好:

passages.original: you have “the grace of God”, sir, and he hath “enough”.
passages.vernacular: 先生,您有「上帝嘅恩典」,佢有「足夠」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,您有「上帝的恩典」,他有「足夠」。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Thou speak’st it well.
passages.vernacular: 你講得好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說得好。

passages.original: Go, father, with thy son.
passages.vernacular: 去,父親,帶住你兒子去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去,父親,帶著你兒子去。

passages.original: Take leave of thy old master, and inquire My lodging out.
passages.vernacular: 向你嘅老主人告別,打聽我嘅住處。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 向你的老主人告別,打聽我的住處。

passages.original: [To a Servant.]
passages.vernacular: [對一名僕人。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [對一名僕人。]

passages.original: Give him a livery More guarded than his fellows’; see it done.
passages.vernacular: 畀佢一套比佢同伴更多花邊嘅制服;睇住辦好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給他一套比他同伴更多花邊的制服;看著辦好。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Father, in.
passages.vernacular: 父親,進去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 父親,進去。

passages.original: I cannot get a service, no!
passages.vernacular: 我得唔到工作,不!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我得不到工作,不!

passages.original: I have ne’er a tongue in my head!
passages.vernacular: 我腦袋裡冇舌頭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我腦袋裡沒舌頭!

passages.original: [Looking on his palm.]
passages.vernacular: [睇著手掌。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [看著手掌。]

passages.original: Well, if any man in Italy have a fairer table which doth offer to swear upon a book, I shall have good fortune;
passages.vernacular: 好,如果意大利有邊個嘅手掌比呢更漂亮,敢對住書發誓,我就會好運;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,如果意大利有誰的手掌比這更漂亮,敢對著書發誓,我就會好運;

passages.original: go to, here’s a simple line of life.
passages.vernacular: 去,呢度係簡單嘅生命線。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去,這裡是簡單的生命線。

passages.original: Here’s a small trifle of wives, alas, fifteen wives is nothing;
passages.vernacular: 呢度有啲點妻子,唉,十五個妻子不算乜嘢;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡有一點點妻子,唉,十五個妻子不算什麼;

passages.original: eleven widows and nine maids is a simple coming-in for one man.
passages.vernacular: 十一個寡婦同九個少女,對一個人來講係簡單嘅收入。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 十一個寡婦和九個少女,對一個人來說是簡單的收入。

passages.original: And then to scape drowning thrice, and to be in peril of my life with the edge of a feather-bed; here are simple ’scapes.
passages.vernacular: 然後三次逃過溺水,並因羽絨床邊緣而有生命危險;呢啲係簡單嘅逃脫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然後三次逃過溺水,並因羽絨床邊緣而有生命危險;這些是簡單的逃脫。

passages.original: Well, if Fortune be a woman, she’s a good wench for this gear.
passages.vernacular: 好,如果命運係女人,佢喺呢件事上係個好姑娘。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,如果命運是女人,她在這件事上是個好姑娘。

passages.original: Father, come; I’ll take my leave of the Jew in the twinkling.
passages.vernacular: 父親,嚟;我要一眨眼就向猶太人告別。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 父親,來;我要一眨眼就向猶太人告別。

passages.original: [Exeunt Launcelet and Old Gobbo.]
passages.vernacular: [朗斯洛特同老高波下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [朗斯洛特與老高波下。]

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: I pray thee, good Leonardo, think on this.
passages.vernacular: 我請你,好李奧納多,想想呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我請你,好李奧納多,想想這個。

passages.original: These things being bought and orderly bestow’d, Return in haste, for I do feast tonight My best esteem’d acquaintance; hie thee, go.
passages.vernacular: 呢啲嘢買好並安排妥當,就迅速回嚟,因為今晚我要宴請我最敬重嘅熟人;去吧,走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些東西買好並安排妥當,就迅速回來,因為今晚我要宴請我最敬重的熟人;去吧,走。

passages.title: Leonardo 李奧納多
passages.original: My best endeavours shall be done herein.
passages.vernacular: 我會盡力而為。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會盡力而為。

passages.original: Enter Gratiano.
passages.vernacular: [葛拉蒂安諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [葛拉蒂安諾上。]

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Where’s your master?
passages.vernacular: 你主人喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你主人在哪裡?

passages.title: Leonardo 李奧納多
passages.original: Yonder, sir, he walks.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰邊走住,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那邊走著,先生。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Signior Bassanio!
passages.vernacular: 巴薩尼奧先生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 巴薩尼奧先生!

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Gratiano!
passages.vernacular: 葛拉蒂安諾!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 葛拉蒂安諾!

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: I have suit to you.
passages.vernacular: 我有個請求要對你講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我有個請求要對你說。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: You have obtain’d it.
passages.vernacular: 你已得到喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你已得到了。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: You must not deny me, I must go with you to Belmont.
passages.vernacular: 你不可拒絕我,我必須同你去貝爾蒙特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不可拒絕我,我必須同你去貝爾蒙特。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Why, then you must.
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰你必須去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那你必須去。

passages.original: But hear thee, Gratiano, Thou art too wild, too rude, and bold of voice, Parts that become thee happily enough, And in such eyes as ours appear not faults;
passages.vernacular: 但聽住,葛拉蒂安諾,你太野,太粗魯,聲音太大,呢啲品質好適合你,喺我哋咁樣嘅眼中不算缺點;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但聽著,葛拉蒂安諾,你太野,太粗魯,聲音太大,這些品質很適合你,在我們這樣的眼中不算缺點;

passages.original: But where thou art not known, why there they show Something too liberal.
passages.vernacular: 但喺不認識你嘅地方,佢哋顯得太放縱。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但在不認識你的地方,它們顯得太放縱。

passages.original: Pray thee, take pain To allay with some cold drops of modesty Thy skipping spirit, lest through thy wild behaviour I be misconst’red in the place I go to, And lose my hopes.
passages.vernacular: 請你費點力,用幾滴冷靜嘅謙遜嚟平息你跳躍嘅精神,免得因你嘅狂放舉止,我喺要去嘅地方被誤解,而失去我嘅希望。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你費點力,用幾滴冷靜的謙遜來平息你跳躍的精神,免得因你的狂放舉止,我在要去的地方被誤解,而失去我的希望。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Signior Bassanio, hear me.
passages.vernacular: 巴薩尼奧先生,聽我講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 巴薩尼奧先生,聽我說。

passages.original: If I do not put on a sober habit, Talk with respect, and swear but now and then, Wear prayer-books in my pocket, look demurely, Nay more, while grace is saying, hood mine eyes Thus with my hat, and sigh, and say “amen”;
passages.vernacular: 如果我不穿上莊重嘅外衣,講話恭敬,只偶爾發誓,口袋裡帶住祈禱書,神態端莊,不但如此,念飯前禱告時,用帽子咁樣遮住眼睛,嘆息並講「阿哋」;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我不穿上莊重的外衣,說話恭敬,只偶爾發誓,口袋裡帶著祈禱書,神態端莊,不但如此,念飯前禱告時,用帽子這樣遮住眼睛,嘆息並說「阿們」;

passages.original: Use all the observance of civility Like one well studied in a sad ostent To please his grandam, never trust me more.
passages.vernacular: 運用一切禮貌嘅規矩,像一個喺悲傷嘅外表上受過良好學習嘅人,嚟取悅佢嘅祖母,就永遠唔好再信我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 運用一切禮貌的規矩,像一個在悲傷的外表上受過良好學習的人,來取悅他的祖母,就永遠別再信我。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Well, we shall see your bearing.
passages.vernacular: 好,我哋睇你嘅表現。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我們看你的表現。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Nay, but I bar tonight, you shall not gauge me By what we do tonight.
passages.vernacular: 不,但我今晚除外,你不可以根據我哋今晚嘅所作所為嚟衡量我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,但我今晚除外,你不可以根據我們今晚的所作所為來衡量我。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: No, that were pity.
passages.vernacular: 不,嗰就可惜喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,那就可惜了。

passages.original: I would entreat you rather to put on Your boldest suit of mirth, for we have friends That purpose merriment.
passages.vernacular: 我倒係請你穿上你最大膽嘅歡樂服裝,因為我哋有朋友打算歡鬧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我倒是請你穿上你最大膽的歡樂服裝,因為我們有朋友打算歡鬧。

passages.original: But fare you well, I have some business.
passages.vernacular: 但再會,我有些事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但再會,我有些事。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: And I must to Lorenzo and the rest, But we will visit you at supper-time.
passages.vernacular: 我必須去找羅倫佐同其他人,但我哋晚飯時會拜訪你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須去找羅倫佐和其他人,但我們晚飯時會拜訪你。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene III — A Room in Shylock’s House 第二幕第三場:夏洛克家一室

passages.original: Enter Jessica and Launcelet.
passages.vernacular: [潔西卡同朗斯洛特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [潔西卡與朗斯洛特上。]

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: I am sorry thou wilt leave my father so.
passages.vernacular: 你要咁樣離開我父親,我好難過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要這樣離開我父親,我很難過。

passages.original: Our house is hell, and thou, a merry devil, Didst rob it of some taste of tediousness.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅家係地獄,你呢個快樂嘅魔鬼,曾為佢奪去幾分沉悶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的家是地獄,你這個快樂的魔鬼,曾為它奪去幾分沉悶。

passages.original: But fare thee well, there is a ducat for thee, And, Launcelet, soon at supper shalt thou see Lorenzo, who is thy new master’s guest.
passages.vernacular: 但再會,呢度有一個杜卡特畀你,朗斯洛特,晚飯時你好快就會見到羅倫佐,佢係你新主人嘅客人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但再會,這裡有一個杜卡特給你,朗斯洛特,晚飯時你很快就會見到羅倫佐,他是你新主人的客人。

passages.original: Give him this letter, do it secretly.
passages.vernacular: 把呢封信交畀佢,要秘密地做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把這封信交給他,要秘密地做。

passages.original: And so farewell.
passages.vernacular: 就咁樣再會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就這樣再會。

passages.original: I would not have my father See me in talk with thee.
passages.vernacular: 我唔想讓我父親睇見我同你講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不想讓我父親看見我和你說話。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Adieu!
passages.vernacular: 再見!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再見!

passages.original: tears exhibit my tongue, most beautiful pagan, most sweet Jew!
passages.vernacular: 眼淚使我嘅舌頭講不出話,最美麗嘅異教徒,最甜美嘅猶太女!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 眼淚使我的舌頭說不出話,最美麗的異教徒,最甜美的猶太女!

passages.original: If a Christian do not play the knave and get thee, I am much deceived. But, adieu!
passages.vernacular: 如果冇一個基督徒耍手段得到你,我就大錯特錯喇。但係,再見!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果沒有一個基督徒耍手段得到你,我就大錯特錯了。但是,再見!

passages.original: These foolish drops do something drown my manly spirit. Adieu!
passages.vernacular: 呢啲傻淚多少淹沒咗我男子漢嘅精神。再見!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這些傻淚多少淹沒了我男子漢的精神。再見!

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Farewell, good Launcelet.
passages.vernacular: 再會,好朗斯洛特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再會,好朗斯洛特。

passages.original: [Exit Launcelet.]
passages.vernacular: [朗斯洛特下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [朗斯洛特下。]

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Alack, what heinous sin is it in me To be ashamed to be my father’s child!
passages.vernacular: 唉,我羞於做我父親嘅細路,呢個係幾咁嚴重嘅罪!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 唉,我羞於做我父親的孩子,這是多麼嚴重的罪!

passages.original: But though I am a daughter to his blood, I am not to his manners.
passages.vernacular: 但雖然我係佢血脈嘅女兒,卻唔係佢品性嘅女兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但雖然我是他血脈的女兒,卻不是他品性的女兒。

passages.original: O Lorenzo, If thou keep promise, I shall end this strife, Become a Christian and thy loving wife.
passages.vernacular: 啊羅倫佐,如果你守信,我就會結束呢爭鬥,成為基督徒同你嘅愛妻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊羅倫佐,如果你守信,我就會結束這爭鬥,成為基督徒和你的愛妻。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene IV — A Street 第二幕第四場:街道

passages.original: Enter Gratiano, Lorenzo, Salarino and Solanio.
passages.vernacular: [葛拉蒂安諾、羅倫佐、薩萊里諾同索拉尼奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [葛拉蒂安諾、羅倫佐、薩萊里諾與索拉尼奧上。]

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Nay, we will slink away in supper-time, Disguise us at my lodging, and return All in an hour.
passages.vernacular: 不,我哋晚飯時溜走,喺我住處喬裝,一小時內全回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,我們晚飯時溜走,在我住處喬裝,一小時內全回來。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: We have not made good preparation.
passages.vernacular: 我哋準備得不好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們準備得不好。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: We have not spoke us yet of torch-bearers.
passages.vernacular: 我哋仲冇談過火炬手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們還沒談過火炬手。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: ’Tis vile, unless it may be quaintly order’d, And better in my mind not undertook.
passages.vernacular: 除非安排得巧妙,否則好差,依我睇,不如不做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 除非安排得巧妙,否則很差,依我看,不如不做。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: ’Tis now but four o’clock, we have two hours To furnish us.
passages.vernacular: 而家才四點,我哋有兩個鐘頭準備。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在才四點,我們有兩個鐘頭準備。

passages.original: Enter Launcelet with a letter.
passages.vernacular: [朗斯洛特攞住一封信上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [朗斯洛特拿著一封信上。]

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Friend Launcelet, what’s the news?
passages.vernacular: 朋友朗斯洛特,有乜嘢消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 朋友朗斯洛特,有什麼消息?

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: And it shall please you to break up this, it shall seem to signify.
passages.vernacular: 如果你肯拆開呢個,佢似乎會講明。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你肯拆開這個,它似乎會說明。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: I know the hand, in faith ’tis a fair hand, And whiter than the paper it writ on Is the fair hand that writ.
passages.vernacular: 我認得呢筆跡,講真嘅係漂亮嘅筆跡,寫字嘅嗰隻美麗嘅手比寫字嘅紙仲要白。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我認得這筆跡,說真的是漂亮的筆跡,寫字的那隻美麗的手比寫字的紙還要白。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Love news, in faith.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,係愛情嘅消息。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,是愛情的消息。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: By your leave, sir.
passages.vernacular: 失禮喇,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 失禮了,先生。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Whither goest thou?
passages.vernacular: 你往邊度去?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你往哪裡去?

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Marry, sir, to bid my old master the Jew to sup tonight with my new master the Christian.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,先生,去請我嘅舊主人猶太人今晚嚟同我嘅新主人基督徒食晚飯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,先生,去請我的舊主人猶太人今晚來和我的新主人基督徒吃晚飯。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Hold here, take this.
passages.vernacular: 攞住,收下呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拿著,收下這個。

passages.original: Tell gentle Jessica I will not fail her, speak it privately.
passages.vernacular: 告訴溫柔嘅潔西卡我唔會讓佢失望,私下講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴溫柔的潔西卡我不會讓她失望,私下說。

passages.original: Go, gentlemen,
passages.vernacular: 走吧,先生哋,
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走吧,先生們,

passages.original: [Exit Launcelet.]
passages.vernacular: [朗斯洛特下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [朗斯洛特下。]

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Will you prepare you for this masque tonight?
passages.vernacular: 你哋為今晚嘅化裝舞會準備好咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們為今晚的化裝舞會準備好了嗎?

passages.original: I am provided of a torch-bearer.
passages.vernacular: 我已備好一個火炬手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已備好一個火炬手。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Ay, marry, I’ll be gone about it straight.
passages.vernacular: 對,講真嘅,我即刻去辦。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,說真的,我馬上去辦。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: And so will I.
passages.vernacular: 我都係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也是。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Meet me and Gratiano At Gratiano’s lodging some hour hence.
passages.vernacular: 一小時後喺葛拉蒂安諾嘅住處同我同葛拉蒂安諾會面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一小時後在葛拉蒂安諾的住處與我和葛拉蒂安諾會面。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: ’Tis good we do so.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣好好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣很好。

passages.original: [Exeunt Salarino and Solanio.]
passages.vernacular: [薩萊里諾同索拉尼奧下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [薩萊里諾與索拉尼奧下。]

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Was not that letter from fair Jessica?
passages.vernacular: 嗰封信唔係美麗嘅潔西卡寫嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那封信不是美麗的潔西卡寫的嗎?

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: I must needs tell thee all.
passages.vernacular: 我必須全都告訴你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須全都告訴你。

passages.original: She hath directed How I shall take her from her father’s house, What gold and jewels she is furnish’d with, What page’s suit she hath in readiness.
passages.vernacular: 佢指示咗我該點樣把佢從佢父親家帶走,佢備有多少金子同珠寶,佢備好咗點樣一套侍童嘅服裝。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她指示了我該怎樣把她從她父親家帶走,她備有多少金子和珠寶,她備好了怎樣一套侍童的服裝。

passages.original: If e’er the Jew her father come to heaven, It will be for his gentle daughter’s sake;
passages.vernacular: 如果佢猶太父親有一天上天堂,嗰將係為了佢溫柔女兒嘅緣故;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果她猶太父親有一天上天堂,那將是為了他溫柔女兒的緣故;

passages.original: And never dare misfortune cross her foot, Unless she do it under this excuse, That she is issue to a faithless Jew.
passages.vernacular: 不幸都永遠唔敢擋佢嘅腳,除非佢以呢個藉口:佢係一個不忠實猶太人嘅女兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不幸也永遠不敢擋她的腳,除非她以這個藉口:她是一個不忠實猶太人的女兒。

passages.original: Come, go with me, peruse this as thou goest; Fair Jessica shall be my torch-bearer.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,跟我走,邊走邊睇呢封信;美麗嘅潔西卡將做我嘅火炬手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,跟我走,邊走邊看這封信;美麗的潔西卡將做我的火炬手。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene V — Before Shylock’s House 第二幕第五場:夏洛克家門前

passages.original: Enter Shylock the Jew and Launcelet his man that was the clown.
passages.vernacular: [夏洛克同曾係小丑嘅僕人朗斯洛特上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [夏洛克和曾是小丑的僕人朗斯洛特上。]

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: Well, thou shalt see, thy eyes shall be thy judge, The difference of old Shylock and Bassanio.— What, Jessica!—Thou shalt not gormandize As thou hast done with me;—What, Jessica!— And sleep, and snore, and rend apparel out.
passages.vernacular: 好,你會睇到,你嘅眼睛將係法官,睇老夏洛克同巴薩尼奧嘅區別。——乜嘢,潔西卡!——你不可以像跟住我時嗰樣暴飲暴食;——乜嘢,潔西卡!——都不可以瞓覺、打鼾、把衣服撕破。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,你會看到,你的眼睛將是法官,看老夏洛克和巴薩尼奧的區別。——什麼,潔西卡!——你不可以像跟著我時那樣暴飲暴食;——什麼,潔西卡!——也不可以睡覺、打鼾、把衣服撕破。

passages.original: Why, Jessica, I say!
passages.vernacular: 哎,潔西卡,我叫你!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,潔西卡,我叫你!

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Why, Jessica!
passages.vernacular: 哎,潔西卡!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,潔西卡!

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: Who bids thee call?
passages.vernacular: 邊個叫你叫嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰叫你叫的?

passages.original: I do not bid thee call.
passages.vernacular: 我冇叫你叫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我沒叫你叫。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: Your worship was wont to tell me I could do nothing without bidding.
passages.vernacular: 閣下以前常講,冇吩咐我乜嘢都唔能夠做。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 閣下以前常說,沒有吩咐我什麼也不能做。

passages.original: Enter Jessica.
passages.vernacular: [潔西卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [潔西卡上。]

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Call you?
passages.vernacular: 您叫我?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您叫我?

passages.original: What is your will?
passages.vernacular: 您有乜嘢吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 您有什麼吩咐?

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: I am bid forth to supper, Jessica.
passages.vernacular: 我被請去食晚飯,潔西卡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我被請去吃晚飯,潔西卡。

passages.original: There are my keys.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我嘅鑰匙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我的鑰匙。

passages.original: But wherefore should I go?
passages.vernacular: 但我點解要去?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我為什麼要去?

passages.original: I am not bid for love, they flatter me.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋請我唔係出於好意,佢哋係喺奉承我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們請我不是出於好意,他們是在奉承我。

passages.original: But yet I’ll go in hate, to feed upon The prodigal Christian.
passages.vernacular: 但我定係要去,出於恨,去食嗰揮霍嘅基督徒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我還是要去,出於恨,去吃那揮霍的基督徒。

passages.original: Jessica, my girl, Look to my house.
passages.vernacular: 潔西卡,我嘅女兒,睇好我嘅房子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 潔西卡,我的女兒,看好我的房子。

passages.original: I am right loath to go; There is some ill a-brewing towards my rest, For I did dream of money-bags tonight.
passages.vernacular: 我好唔想去;有乜嘢壞事喺醞釀,要擾亂我嘅安寧,因為我今晚夢見錢袋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很不想去;有什麼壞事在醞釀,要擾亂我的安寧,因為我今晚夢見錢袋。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: I beseech you, sir, go.
passages.vernacular: 我懇求您,先生,去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我懇求您,先生,去吧。

passages.original: My young master doth expect your reproach.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅年輕主人期待您嘅指責。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的年輕主人期待您的指責。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: So do I his.
passages.vernacular: 我都期待佢嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也期待他的。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: And they have conspired together.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋已經一起合謀喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們已經一起合謀了。

passages.original: I will not say you shall see a masque, but if you do, then it was not for nothing that my nose fell a-bleeding on Black Monday last at six o’clock i’ th’ morning, falling out that year on Ash-Wednesday was four year in th’ afternoon.
passages.vernacular: 我不講您會睇到化裝舞會,但如果您睇到,咁我上個黑色星期一早晨六點鼻子流血就唔係冇原因嘅,嗰年正好碰上四年前嘅聖灰星期三下午。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不說您會看到化裝舞會,但如果您看到,那麼我上個黑色星期一早晨六點鼻子流血就不是沒有原因的,那年正好碰上四年前的聖灰星期三下午。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: What, are there masques?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,有化裝舞會?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,有化裝舞會?

passages.original: Hear you me, Jessica, Lock up my doors, and when you hear the drum And the vile squealing of the wry-neck’d fife, Clamber not you up to the casements then, Nor thrust your head into the public street To gaze on Christian fools with varnish’d faces, But stop my house’s ears, I mean my casements.
passages.vernacular: 聽住,潔西卡,鎖好我嘅門,當你聽到鼓聲同歪脖子笛子嘅難聽尖叫聲時,唔好爬到窗邊,都唔好把頭伸到公共街道上,去睇嗰啲臉上塗咗油彩嘅基督徒傻瓜,而要堵住我房子嘅耳朵,我係講窗戶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽著,潔西卡,鎖好我的門,當你聽到鼓聲和歪脖子笛子的難聽尖叫聲時,不要爬到窗邊,也不要把頭伸到公共街道上,去看那些臉上塗了油彩的基督徒傻瓜,而要堵住我房子的耳朵,我是說窗戶。

passages.original: Let not the sound of shallow fopp’ry enter My sober house.
passages.vernacular: 唔好讓淺薄花哨嘅聲音進入我清靜嘅房子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要讓淺薄花哨的聲音進入我清靜的房子。

passages.original: By Jacob’s staff I swear I have no mind of feasting forth tonight.
passages.vernacular: 憑雅各嘅杖我起誓,我今晚冇外出赴宴嘅心思。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 憑雅各的杖我起誓,我今晚沒有外出赴宴的心思。

passages.original: But I will go.
passages.vernacular: 但我定係要去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但我還是要去。

passages.original: Go you before me, sirrah.
passages.vernacular: 你先走,小子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你先走,小子。

passages.original: Say I will come.
passages.vernacular: 講我會嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說我會來。

passages.title: Launcelot 朗斯洛特
passages.original: I will go before, sir.
passages.vernacular: 我先走,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我先走,先生。

passages.original: Mistress, look out at window for all this.
passages.vernacular: 小姐,儘管如此,定係要從窗口睇睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小姐,儘管如此,還是要從窗口看看。

passages.original: There will come a Christian by Will be worth a Jewess’ eye.
passages.vernacular: 會有一個基督徒經過,值得猶太女人嘅眼睛睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 會有一個基督徒經過,值得猶太女人的眼睛看。

passages.original: [Exit Launcelet.]
passages.vernacular: [朗斯洛特下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [朗斯洛特下。]

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: What says that fool of Hagar’s offspring, ha?
passages.vernacular: 嗰傻瓜,夏甲嘅後代,講乜嘢喇,哈?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那傻瓜,夏甲的後代,說什麼了,哈?

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: His words were “Farewell, mistress,” nothing else.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅話係「再會,小姐」,冇別嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的話是「再會,小姐」,沒有別的。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: The patch is kind enough, but a huge feeder, Snail-slow in profit, and he sleeps by day More than the wild-cat.
passages.vernacular: 呢小丑夠和善,但係個大飯桶,賺錢蝸牛般慢,白天瞓得比野貓仲多。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這小丑夠和善,但是個大飯桶,賺錢蝸牛般慢,白天睡得比野貓還多。

passages.original: Drones hive not with me, Therefore I part with him, and part with him To one that I would have him help to waste His borrowed purse.
passages.vernacular: 雄蜂不喺我呢度築巢,所以我讓佢走,讓佢去幫一個我想要佢幫忙揮霍借嚟嘅錢包嘅人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雄蜂不在我這裡築巢,所以我讓他走,讓他去幫一個我想要他幫忙揮霍借來的錢包的人。

passages.original: Well, Jessica, go in.
passages.vernacular: 好,潔西卡,進去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,潔西卡,進去。

passages.original: Perhaps I will return immediately: Do as I bid you, shut doors after you, “Fast bind, fast find.”
passages.vernacular: 或者我會即刻回嚟:照我吩咐嘅做,出門後把門關上,「緊緊綁住,緊緊找到」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也許我會馬上回來:照我吩咐的做,出門後把門關上,「緊緊綁住,緊緊找到」。

passages.original: A proverb never stale in thrifty mind.
passages.vernacular: 呢句諺語喺節儉人心中永不過時。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這句諺語在節儉人心中永不過時。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Farewell, and if my fortune be not crost, I have a father, you a daughter, lost.
passages.vernacular: 再會,如果我嘅運氣冇被擋住,我失去咗一個父親,你失去咗一個女兒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再會,如果我的運氣沒被擋住,我失去了一個父親,你失去了一個女兒。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene VI — The Same 第二幕第六場:同一地點

passages.original: Enter the masquers, Gratiano and Salarino.
passages.vernacular: [蒙面者葛拉蒂安諾同薩萊里諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [蒙面者葛拉蒂安諾與薩萊里諾上。]

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: This is the penthouse under which Lorenzo Desired us to make stand.
passages.vernacular: 呢個就係羅倫佐要我哋站住嘅屋簷下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這就是羅倫佐要我們站住的屋簷下。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: His hour is almost past.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅時間差不多過喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的時間差不多過了。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: And it is marvel he out-dwells his hour, For lovers ever run before the clock.
passages.vernacular: 佢超時好奇怪,因為戀人總是跑喺鐘前面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他超時很奇怪,因為戀人總是跑在鐘前面。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: O ten times faster Venus’ pigeons fly To seal love’s bonds new-made than they are wont To keep obliged faith unforfeited!
passages.vernacular: 維納斯嘅鴿子為了封印新結嘅愛情,飛得比平時為了持守不失嘅信義要快十倍!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 維納斯的鴿子為了封印新結的愛情,飛得比平時為了持守不失的信義要快十倍!

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: That ever holds: who riseth from a feast With that keen appetite that he sits down?
passages.vernacular: 呢永遠成立:邊個從宴席起身時,仲有入席時嗰樣敏銳嘅胃口?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這永遠成立:誰從宴席起身時,還有入席時那樣敏銳的胃口?

passages.original: Where is the horse that doth untread again His tedious measures with the unbated fire That he did pace them first?
passages.vernacular: 邊匹馬會以最初嗰樣不減嘅熱情,重新走一遍佢冗長嘅步伐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哪匹馬會以最初那樣不減的熱情,重新走一遍它冗長的步伐?

passages.original: All things that are, Are with more spirit chased than enjoy’d.
passages.vernacular: 世上一切事物,追求時總比享有時更有精神。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世上一切事物,追求時總比享有時更有精神。

passages.original: How like a younger or a prodigal The scarfed bark puts from her native bay, Hugg’d and embraced by the strumpet wind!
passages.vernacular: 嗰披住旗幟嘅船離開故鄉海灣時,多像一個少年或浪子,被輕浮嘅風擁抱!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那披著旗幟的船離開故鄉海灣時,多像一個少年或浪子,被輕浮的風擁抱!

passages.original: How like the prodigal doth she return With over-weather’d ribs and ragged sails, Lean, rent, and beggar’d by the strumpet wind!
passages.vernacular: 佢回嚟時多像嗰浪子,船肋被風雨磨穿,帆破爛不堪,瘦削、破裂,被輕浮嘅風弄得一貧如洗!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她回來時多像那浪子,船肋被風雨磨穿,帆破爛不堪,瘦削、破裂,被輕浮的風弄得一貧如洗!

passages.original: Enter Lorenzo.
passages.vernacular: [羅倫佐上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅倫佐上。]

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Here comes Lorenzo, more of this hereafter.
passages.vernacular: 羅倫佐嚟喇,呢事以後再講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅倫佐來了,這事以後再說。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Sweet friends, your patience for my long abode.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅朋友哋,對我久留請多包涵。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的朋友們,對我久留請多包涵。

passages.original: Not I but my affairs have made you wait.
passages.vernacular: 唔係我,而係我嘅事務讓你哋久等。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不是我,而是我的事務讓你們久等。

passages.original: When you shall please to play the thieves for wives, I’ll watch as long for you then. Approach.
passages.vernacular: 等你哋邊天想為妻子當賊,我都會同樣等你哋。走近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 等你們哪天想為妻子當賊,我也會同樣等你們。走近。

passages.original: Here dwells my father Jew. Ho!
passages.vernacular: 我猶太父親住喺呢度。喂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我猶太父親住在這裡。喂!

passages.original: who’s within?
passages.vernacular: 裡面係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 裡面是誰?

passages.original: Enter Jessica above, in boy’s clothes.
passages.vernacular: [潔西卡穿男孩衣服喺上面上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [潔西卡穿男孩衣服在上面上。]

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Who are you?
passages.vernacular: 你係邊個?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是誰?

passages.original: Tell me, for more certainty, Albeit I’ll swear that I do know your tongue.
passages.vernacular: 告訴我,為了更確定,雖然我發誓我認得你嘅聲音。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴我,為了更確定,雖然我發誓我認得你的聲音。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Lorenzo, and thy love.
passages.vernacular: 羅倫佐,同你嘅愛人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 羅倫佐,和你的愛人。

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Lorenzo certain, and my love indeed, For who love I so much?
passages.vernacular: 確實係羅倫佐,確實係我嘅愛人,因為我仲愛邊個咁深?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實是羅倫佐,確實是我的愛人,因為我還愛誰這麼深?

passages.original: And now who knows But you, Lorenzo, whether I am yours?
passages.vernacular: 而家除咗你,羅倫佐,邊個知道我係唔係你嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在除了你,羅倫佐,誰知道我是不是你的?

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Heaven and thy thoughts are witness that thou art.
passages.vernacular: 上天同你嘅心思都可以作證你係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 上天和你的心思都可以作證你是。

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: Here, catch this casket; it is worth the pains.
passages.vernacular: 呢度,接住呢個小匣子;值得費呢個力。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡,接住這個小匣子;值得費這個力。

passages.original: I am glad ’tis night, you do not look on me, For I am much asham’d of my exchange.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興係夜晚,你睇唔見我,因為我為我嘅改裝好羞愧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興是夜晚,你看不見我,因為我為我的改裝非常羞愧。

passages.original: But love is blind, and lovers cannot see The pretty follies that themselves commit, For if they could, Cupid himself would blush To see me thus transformed to a boy.
passages.vernacular: 但愛情係盲嘅,戀人睇唔見自己所做嘅可愛嘅蠢事,因為如果睇得見,連丘比特自己都會臉紅,睇到我咁樣變成男孩。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但愛情是盲的,戀人看不見自己所做的可愛的蠢事,因為如果看得見,連丘比特自己也會臉紅,看到我這樣變成男孩。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Descend, for you must be my torch-bearer.
passages.vernacular: 下嚟,因為你必須做我嘅火炬手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 下來,因為你必須做我的火炬手。

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: What!
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼!

passages.original: must I hold a candle to my shames?
passages.vernacular: 我必須為我嘅羞恥執燈嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我必須為我的羞恥執燈嗎?

passages.original: They in themselves, good sooth, are too too light.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋本身講真嘅已經太輕浮喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 它們本身說真的已經太輕浮了。

passages.original: Why, ’tis an office of discovery, love, And I should be obscur’d.
passages.vernacular: 哎,呢個係個揭露嘅差事,愛人,而我應該隱藏。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,這是個揭露的差事,愛人,而我應該隱藏。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: So are you, sweet, Even in the lovely garnish of a boy.
passages.vernacular: 你都係隱藏嘅,親愛嘅,即使穿住男孩可愛嘅裝束。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你也是隱藏的,親愛的,即使穿著男孩可愛的裝束。

passages.original: But come at once, For the close night doth play the runaway, And we are stay’d for at Bassanio’s feast.
passages.vernacular: 但即刻嚟,因為緊閉嘅夜晚喺逃走,我哋喺巴薩尼奧嘅宴會上被等住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但馬上來,因為緊閉的夜晚在逃走,我們在巴薩尼奧的宴會上被等著。

passages.title: Jessica 潔西卡
passages.original: I will make fast the doors, and gild myself With some moe ducats, and be with you straight.
passages.vernacular: 我要把門關緊,再畀自己鍍上啲杜卡特,即刻就嚟找你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要把門關緊,再給自己鍍上一些杜卡特,馬上就來找你。

passages.original: [Exit above.]
passages.vernacular: [喺上面下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [在上面下。]

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Now, by my hood, a gentle, and no Jew.
passages.vernacular: 而家,憑我嘅頭巾,佢係溫和嘅,唔係猶太人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,憑我的頭巾,她是溫和的,不是猶太人。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Beshrew me but I love her heartily, For she is wise, if I can judge of her, And fair she is, if that mine eyes be true, And true she is, as she hath prov’d herself.
passages.vernacular: 我若不衷心愛佢就該詛咒,因為佢聰明,如果我能判斷佢,佢美麗,如果我嘅眼睛可靠,佢忠實,正如佢已證明嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我若不衷心愛她就該詛咒,因為她聰明,如果我能判斷她,她美麗,如果我的眼睛可靠,她忠實,正如她已證明的。

passages.original: And therefore, like herself, wise, fair, and true, Shall she be placed in my constant soul.
passages.vernacular: 所以,像佢自己一樣,聰明、美麗、忠實,佢將被安放喺我堅定嘅靈魂中。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以,像她自己一樣,聰明、美麗、忠實,她將被安放在我堅定的靈魂中。

passages.original: Enter Jessica.
passages.vernacular: [潔西卡上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [潔西卡上。]

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: What, art thou come?
passages.vernacular: 點,你嚟喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼,你來了?

passages.original: On, gentlemen, away!
passages.vernacular: 前進,先生哋,走!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 前進,先生們,走!

passages.original: Our masquing mates by this time for us stay.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅化裝夥伴呢陣正等住我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的化裝夥伴這時正等著我們。

passages.original: [Exit with Jessica and Salarino.]
passages.vernacular: [偕潔西卡同薩萊里諾下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [偕潔西卡與薩萊里諾下。]

passages.original: Enter Antonio.
passages.vernacular: [安東尼奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [安東尼奧上。]

passages.title: Antonio 安東尼奧
passages.original: Who’s there?
passages.vernacular: 邊個喺嗰度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰在那裡?

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Signior Antonio!
passages.vernacular: 安東尼奧先生!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安東尼奧先生!

passages.title: Antonio 安東尼奧
passages.original: Fie, fie, Gratiano!
passages.vernacular: 呸,呸,葛拉蒂安諾!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,呸,葛拉蒂安諾!

passages.original: where are all the rest?
passages.vernacular: 其他人都喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其他人都在哪裡?

passages.original: ’Tis nine o’clock, our friends all stay for you.
passages.vernacular: 九點鐘喇,我哋嘅朋友哋都喺等你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 九點鐘了,我們的朋友們都在等你。

passages.original: No masque tonight, the wind is come about; Bassanio presently will go aboard.
passages.vernacular: 今晚冇化裝舞會,風向轉喇;巴薩尼奧即刻要上船。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 今晚沒有化裝舞會,風向轉了;巴薩尼奧馬上要上船。

passages.original: I have sent twenty out to seek for you.
passages.vernacular: 我派咗二十個人去找你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我派了二十個人去找你。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: I am glad on’t.
passages.vernacular: 我好高興。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我很高興。

passages.original: I desire no more delight Than to be under sail and gone tonight.
passages.vernacular: 我唔好更多嘅快樂,只要今晚揚帆出發。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不要更多的快樂,只要今晚揚帆出發。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene VII — Belmont. A Room in Portia’s House 第二幕第七場:貝爾蒙特,鮑西婭家一室

passages.original: Flourish of cornets. Enter Portia with the Prince of Morocco and both their trains.
passages.vernacular: [號角齊鳴。鮑西婭偕摩洛哥親王,及雙方侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [號角齊鳴。鮑西婭偕摩洛哥親王,及雙方侍從上。]

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Go, draw aside the curtains and discover The several caskets to this noble prince.
passages.vernacular: 去,拉開帷幕,向呢位高貴嘅親王揭示幾個匣子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去,拉開帷幕,向這位高貴的親王揭示幾個匣子。

passages.original: Now make your choice.
passages.vernacular: 而家請作選擇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在請作選擇。

passages.title: Prince of Morocco 摩洛哥親王
passages.original: The first, of gold, who this inscription bears, “Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire.”
passages.vernacular: 第一個,金嘅,刻住呢銘文:「選我者將得眾人所欲。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 第一個,金的,刻著這銘文:「選我者將得眾人所欲。」

passages.original: The second, silver, which this promise carries, “Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves.”
passages.vernacular: 第二個,銀嘅,帶住呢個承諾:「選我者將得其所應得。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 第二個,銀的,帶著這個承諾:「選我者將得其所應得。」

passages.original: This third, dull lead, with warning all as blunt, “Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath.”
passages.vernacular: 呢第三個,暗淡嘅鉛,警告同樣直白:「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下佢一切所有。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這第三個,暗淡的鉛,警告同樣直白:「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下他一切所有。」

passages.original: How shall I know if I do choose the right?
passages.vernacular: 我點知道我選對喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我怎麼知道我選對了?

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: The one of them contains my picture, prince.
passages.vernacular: 其中一個裝住我嘅畫像,親王。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其中一個裝著我的畫像,親王。

passages.original: If you choose that, then I am yours withal.
passages.vernacular: 如果你選嗰個,我都連同屬於你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你選那個,我也連同屬於你。

passages.title: Prince of Morocco 摩洛哥親王
passages.original: Some god direct my judgment! Let me see.
passages.vernacular: 願神指引我嘅判斷!讓我睇睇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願神指引我的判斷!讓我看看。

passages.original: I will survey the inscriptions back again.
passages.vernacular: 我再嚟細睇一遍銘文。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我再來細看一遍銘文。

passages.original: What says this leaden casket?
passages.vernacular: 呢鉛匣講乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這鉛匣說什麼?

passages.original: “Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下佢一切所有。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下他一切所有。」

passages.original: Must give, for what? For lead?
passages.vernacular: 必須付出,點解?為了鉛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 必須付出,為什麼?為了鉛?

passages.original: Hazard for lead!
passages.vernacular: 為鉛冒險!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 為鉛冒險!

passages.original: This casket threatens; men that hazard all Do it in hope of fair advantages:
passages.vernacular: 呢個匣子帶住威脅;冒險拋下一切嘅人,係希望得到美好嘅好處:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個匣子帶著威脅;冒險拋下一切的人,是希望得到美好的好處:

passages.original: A golden mind stoops not to shows of dross, I’ll then nor give nor hazard aught for lead.
passages.vernacular: 金子般嘅心唔會彎腰去睇渣滓嘅表象,所以我唔會為鉛付出或冒險任何嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 金子般的心不會彎腰去看渣滓的表象,所以我不會為鉛付出或冒險任何東西。

passages.original: What says the silver with her virgin hue?
passages.vernacular: 嗰帶住處女顏色嘅銀匣講乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那帶著處女顏色的銀匣說什麼?

passages.original: “Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者將得其所應得。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者將得其所應得。」

passages.original: As much as he deserves!
passages.vernacular: 其所應得!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其所應得!

passages.original: Pause there, Morocco, And weigh thy value with an even hand.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰度停一停,摩洛哥,用公平嘅手稱你嘅價值。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那裡停一停,摩洛哥,用公平的手稱你的價值。

passages.original: If thou be’st rated by thy estimation Thou dost deserve enough, and yet enough May not extend so far as to the lady.
passages.vernacular: 若按你自己嘅估計嚟衡量,你應得嘅已經夠多,不過夠多或者仲唔夠到達小姐嗰度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 若按你自己的估計來衡量,你應得的已經夠多,可是夠多也許還不夠到達小姐那裡。

passages.original: And yet to be afeard of my deserving Were but a weak disabling of myself.
passages.vernacular: 然而害怕我嘅應得,不過係軟弱地貶低自己。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 然而害怕我的應得,不過是軟弱地貶低自己。

passages.original: As much as I deserve!
passages.vernacular: 其所應得!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其所應得!

passages.original: Why, that’s the lady: I do in birth deserve her, and in fortunes, In graces, and in qualities of breeding;
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰個就係小姐:我喺出身上配得上佢,喺財富上、喺風度上、喺教養嘅品質上;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那就是小姐:我在出身上配得上她,在財富上、在風度上、在教養的品質上;

passages.original: But more than these, in love I do deserve.
passages.vernacular: 但比呢啲更重要嘅,我喺愛情上配得上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但比這些更重要的,我在愛情上配得上。

passages.original: What if I stray’d no farther, but chose here?
passages.vernacular: 如果我唔再走遠,就喺呢度選呢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我不再走遠,就在這裡選呢?

passages.original: Let’s see once more this saying grav’d in gold:
passages.vernacular: 讓我哋再睇一次呢金子上刻嘅話:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我們再看一次這金子上刻的話:

passages.original: “Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者將得眾人所欲。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者將得眾人所欲。」

passages.original: Why, that’s the lady, all the world desires her.
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰個就係小姐,全世界都想要佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那就是小姐,全世界都想要她。

passages.original: From the four corners of the earth they come To kiss this shrine, this mortal breathing saint.
passages.vernacular: 從地球嘅四個角落,佢哋前嚟親吻呢座神龕,呢位呼吸住嘅凡間聖徒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從地球的四個角落,他們前來親吻這座神龕,這位呼吸著的凡間聖徒。

passages.original: The Hyrcanian deserts and the vasty wilds Of wide Arabia are as throughfares now For princes to come view fair Portia.
passages.vernacular: 海爾卡尼亞嘅沙漠同廣袤阿拉伯嘅荒野,如今成咗王子哋嚟睇美麗鮑西婭嘅通衢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 海爾卡尼亞的沙漠和廣袤阿拉伯的荒野,如今成了王子們來看美麗鮑西婭的通衢。

passages.original: The watery kingdom, whose ambitious head Spets in the face of heaven, is no bar To stop the foreign spirits, but they come As o’er a brook to see fair Portia.
passages.vernacular: 嗰水嘅王國,佢雄心勃勃嘅頭顱朝天吐唾沫,都擋不住外邦嘅靈魂,佢哋像跨過小溪一樣嚟睇美麗嘅鮑西婭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那水的王國,它雄心勃勃的頭顱朝天吐唾沫,也擋不住外邦的靈魂,他們像跨過小溪一樣來看美麗的鮑西婭。

passages.original: One of these three contains her heavenly picture.
passages.vernacular: 呢三個之一裝住佢天上嘅畫像。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這三個之一裝著她天上的畫像。

passages.original: Is’t like that lead contains her?
passages.vernacular: 難道鉛裝住佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 難道鉛裝著她?

passages.original: ’Twere damnation To think so base a thought.
passages.vernacular: 想咁樣卑賤嘅念頭係該受詛咒嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 想這樣卑賤的念頭是該受詛咒的。

passages.original: It were too gross To rib her cerecloth in the obscure grave.
passages.vernacular: 把佢嘅裹屍布喺昏暗嘅墳墓裡都太粗劣喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把她的裹屍布在昏暗的墳墓裡也太粗劣了。

passages.original: Or shall I think in silver she’s immur’d Being ten times undervalued to tried gold?
passages.vernacular: 定係我該想佢被關喺銀匣裡,嗰比精煉過嘅金子便宜咗十倍?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是我該想她被關在銀匣裡,那比精煉過的金子便宜了十倍?

passages.original: O sinful thought!
passages.vernacular: 啊罪惡嘅念頭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊罪惡的念頭!

passages.original: Never so rich a gem Was set in worse than gold.
passages.vernacular: 從冇咁樣富貴嘅寶石鑲喺比金子更差嘅嘢裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 從沒有這樣富貴的寶石鑲在比金子更差的東西裡。

passages.original: They have in England A coin that bears the figure of an angel Stamped in gold;
passages.vernacular: 佢哋喺英格蘭有一種硬幣,上面鑄住天使嘅形象,金質嘅;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們在英格蘭有一種硬幣,上面鑄著天使的形象,金質的;

passages.original: but that’s insculp’d upon; But here an angel in a golden bed Lies all within.
passages.vernacular: 但嗰個係刻喺表面;可呢度一位天使躺喺金床上,全喺裡面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但那是刻在表面;可這裡一位天使躺在金床上,全在裡面。

passages.original: Deliver me the key.
passages.vernacular: 把鑰匙畀我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 把鑰匙給我。

passages.original: Here do I choose, and thrive I as I may.
passages.vernacular: 我喺呢度選擇,成敗由命。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這裡選擇,成敗由命。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: There, take it, prince, and if my form lie there, Then I am yours.
passages.vernacular: 攞住,親王,如果我嘅像喺嗰度面,嗰我就屬於你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拿著,親王,如果我的像在那裡面,那我就屬於你。

passages.original: [He unlocks the golden casket.]
passages.vernacular: [佢打開金匣。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [他打開金匣。]

passages.title: Prince of Morocco 摩洛哥親王
passages.original: O hell!
passages.vernacular: 啊地獄!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊地獄!

passages.original: what have we here?
passages.vernacular: 呢度係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡是什麼?

passages.original: A carrion Death, within whose empty eye There is a written scroll.
passages.vernacular: 一具腐爛嘅死屍,空洞嘅眼窩裡有一卷寫住字嘅紙。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一具腐爛的死屍,空洞的眼窩裡有一卷寫著字的紙。

passages.original: I’ll read the writing.
passages.vernacular: 我嚟讀呢啲字。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來讀這些字。

passages.title: Prince of Morocco 摩洛哥親王
passages.original: All that glisters is not gold, Often have you heard that told.
passages.vernacular: 閃光嘅並不全係金子,你常聽人咁樣講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 閃光的並不全是金子,你常聽人這樣說。

passages.original: Many a man his life hath sold But my outside to behold.
passages.vernacular: 許多人賣咗自己嘅命,只為睇我嘅外表。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 許多人賣了自己的命,只為看我的外表。

passages.original: Gilded tombs do worms infold.
passages.vernacular: 鍍金嘅墳墓裡裹住蛆蟲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 鍍金的墳墓裡裹著蛆蟲。

passages.original: Had you been as wise as bold, Young in limbs, in judgment old, Your answer had not been inscroll’d, Fare you well, your suit is cold.
passages.vernacular: 如果你既智慧又勇敢,四肢年輕,判斷老成,你嘅答案就唔會被寫喺卷軸裡,再會,你嘅求婚冷喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果你既智慧又勇敢,四肢年輕,判斷老成,你的答案就不會被寫在卷軸裡,再會,你的求婚冷了。

passages.title: Prince of Morocco 摩洛哥親王
passages.original: Cold indeed and labour lost, Then farewell heat, and welcome frost.
passages.vernacular: 確實係冷喇,辛勞白費,咁再會熱情,歡迎寒霜。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實是冷了,辛勞白費,那麼再會熱情,歡迎寒霜。

passages.original: Portia, adieu!
passages.vernacular: 鮑西婭,再會!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 鮑西婭,再會!

passages.original: I have too griev’d a heart To take a tedious leave.
passages.vernacular: 我心太悲傷,唔能夠講冗長嘅告別。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我心太悲傷,不能說冗長的告別。

passages.original: Thus losers part.
passages.vernacular: 輸家就咁樣離開。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 輸家就這樣離開。

passages.original: [Exit with his train. Flourish of cornets.]
passages.vernacular: [偕侍從下。號角齊鳴。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [偕侍從下。號角齊鳴。]

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: A gentle riddance.
passages.vernacular: 溫和地擺脫喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 溫和地擺脫了。

passages.original: Draw the curtains, go.
passages.vernacular: 拉上帷幕,去吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 拉上帷幕,去吧。

passages.original: Let all of his complexion choose me so.
passages.vernacular: 願所有佢嗰膚色嘅人都咁樣選我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願所有他那膚色的人都這樣選我。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene VIII — Venice. A Street 第二幕第八場:威尼斯街道

passages.original: Enter Salarino and Solanio.
passages.vernacular: [薩萊里諾同索拉尼奧上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [薩萊里諾與索拉尼奧上。]

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Why, man, I saw Bassanio under sail; With him is Gratiano gone along;
passages.vernacular: 哎,老兄,我睇見巴薩尼奧揚帆喇;葛拉蒂安諾同佢同行;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,老兄,我看見巴薩尼奧揚帆了;葛拉蒂安諾與他同行;

passages.original: And in their ship I am sure Lorenzo is not.
passages.vernacular: 我確信羅倫佐不喺佢哋嘅船上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我確信羅倫佐不在他們的船上。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: The villain Jew with outcries rais’d the Duke, Who went with him to search Bassanio’s ship.
passages.vernacular: 嗰惡棍猶太人大聲呼喊驚動咗公爵,公爵隨佢去搜查巴薩尼奧嘅船。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那惡棍猶太人大聲呼喊驚動了公爵,公爵隨他去搜查巴薩尼奧的船。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: He came too late, the ship was under sail; But there the Duke was given to understand That in a gondola were seen together Lorenzo and his amorous Jessica.
passages.vernacular: 佢嚟得太遲,船已揚帆;但喺嗰度公爵被告知,睇見羅倫佐同佢多情嘅潔西卡一同喺一條小船上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他來得太遲,船已揚帆;但在那裡公爵被告知,看見羅倫佐和他多情的潔西卡一同在一條小船上。

passages.original: Besides, Antonio certified the Duke They were not with Bassanio in his ship.
passages.vernacular: 此外,安東尼奧向公爵證明佢哋不喺巴薩尼奧嘅船上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 此外,安東尼奧向公爵證明他們不在巴薩尼奧的船上。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: I never heard a passion so confus’d, So strange, outrageous, and so variable As the dog Jew did utter in the streets.
passages.vernacular: 我從冇聽過如此混亂、奇怪、粗暴而又多變嘅激情,像嗰狗猶太人喺街上吐出嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我從沒聽過如此混亂、奇怪、粗暴而又多變的激情,像那狗猶太人在街上吐出的。

passages.original: “My daughter!
passages.vernacular: 「我嘅女兒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「我的女兒!

passages.original: O my ducats!
passages.vernacular: 啊我嘅杜卡特!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我的杜卡特!

passages.original: O my daughter!
passages.vernacular: 啊我嘅女兒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我的女兒!

passages.original: Fled with a Christian!
passages.vernacular: 同一個基督徒私奔喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與一個基督徒私奔了!

passages.original: O my Christian ducats! Justice! the law!
passages.vernacular: 啊我嘅基督徒杜卡特!正義!法律!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊我的基督徒杜卡特!正義!法律!

passages.original: my ducats and my daughter!
passages.vernacular: 我嘅杜卡特同我嘅女兒!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的杜卡特和我的女兒!

passages.original: A sealed bag, two sealed bags of ducats, Of double ducats, stol’n from me by my daughter!
passages.vernacular: 一個封好嘅袋子,兩個封好嘅杜卡特袋子,雙倍杜卡特,被我女兒偷走喇!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個封好的袋子,兩個封好的杜卡特袋子,雙倍杜卡特,被我女兒偷走了!

passages.original: And jewels, two stones, two rich and precious stones, Stol’n by my daughter! Justice!
passages.vernacular: 仲有珠寶,兩顆寶石,兩顆貴重嘅寶石,被我女兒偷走喇!正義!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有珠寶,兩顆寶石,兩顆貴重的寶石,被我女兒偷走了!正義!

passages.original: find the girl, She hath the stones upon her and the ducats.”
passages.vernacular: 找到嗰丫頭,佢身上帶住寶石同杜卡特。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 找到那丫頭,她身上帶著寶石和杜卡特。」

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Why, all the boys in Venice follow him, Crying, his stones, his daughter, and his ducats.
passages.vernacular: 哎,威尼斯所有嘅男孩都跟住佢,喊住佢嘅寶石,佢嘅女兒,佢嘅杜卡特。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,威尼斯所有的男孩都跟著他,喊著他的寶石,他的女兒,他的杜卡特。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Let good Antonio look he keep his day Or he shall pay for this.
passages.vernacular: 好安東尼奧最好留意守住佢嘅期限,否則佢要為此付出代價。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好安東尼奧最好留意守住他的期限,否則他要為此付出代價。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Marry, well rememb’red.
passages.vernacular: 講真嘅,提醒得好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說真的,提醒得好。

passages.original: I reason’d with a Frenchman yesterday, Who told me, in the narrow seas that part The French and English, there miscarried A vessel of our country richly fraught.
passages.vernacular: 我尋日同一個法國人談過話,佢告訴我,喺隔開法國同英國嘅窄海上,我國一艘滿載貨物嘅船失事喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我昨天和一個法國人談過話,他告訴我,在隔開法國和英國的窄海上,我國一艘滿載貨物的船失事了。

passages.original: I thought upon Antonio when he told me, And wish’d in silence that it were not his.
passages.vernacular: 佢告訴我時我想起安東尼奧,默默希望嗰唔係佢嘅船。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他告訴我時我想起安東尼奧,默默希望那不是他的船。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: You were best to tell Antonio what you hear, Yet do not suddenly, for it may grieve him.
passages.vernacular: 你最好把你聽到嘅告訴安東尼奧,但唔好突然講,因為可能使佢傷心。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你最好把你聽到的告訴安東尼奧,但不要突然說,因為可能使他傷心。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: A kinder gentleman treads not the earth.
passages.vernacular: 大地上冇比佢更和善嘅紳士喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大地上沒有比他更和善的紳士了。

passages.original: I saw Bassanio and Antonio part, Bassanio told him he would make some speed Of his return.
passages.vernacular: 我睇見巴薩尼奧同安東尼奧告別,巴薩尼奧告訴佢會儘快回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我看見巴薩尼奧和安東尼奧告別,巴薩尼奧告訴他會儘快回來。

passages.original: He answered “Do not so, Slubber not business for my sake, Bassanio, But stay the very riping of the time, And for the Jew’s bond which he hath of me, Let it not enter in your mind of love:
passages.vernacular: 佢回答:「唔好咁樣,為了我唔好草率處理事務,巴薩尼奧,而要等到時機完全成熟,至於嗰猶太人持有我嘅契約,唔好畀佢進入你充滿愛嘅心:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他回答:「不要這樣,為了我不要草率處理事務,巴薩尼奧,而要等到時機完全成熟,至於那猶太人持有我的契約,別讓它進入你充滿愛的心:

passages.original: Be merry, and employ your chiefest thoughts To courtship, and such fair ostents of love As shall conveniently become you there.”
passages.vernacular: 要快樂,把你最主要嘅心思用喺求愛,同喺嗰度適合你嘅美好愛嘅表示上。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要快樂,把你最主要的心思用在求愛,和在那裡適合你的美好愛的表示上。」

passages.original: And even there, his eye being big with tears, Turning his face, he put his hand behind him, And with affection wondrous sensible He wrung Bassanio’s hand, and so they parted.
passages.vernacular: 就喺嗰度,佢嘅眼裡噙滿淚水,轉過臉,把手伸向身後,以驚人敏感嘅深情緊握巴薩尼奧嘅手,然後佢哋就分開喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就在那裡,他的眼裡噙滿淚水,轉過臉,把手伸向身後,以驚人敏感的深情緊握巴薩尼奧的手,然後他們就分開了。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: I think he only loves the world for him.
passages.vernacular: 我想佢只為佢而愛呢個世界。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想他只為他而愛這個世界。

passages.original: I pray thee, let us go and find him out And quicken his embraced heaviness With some delight or other.
passages.vernacular: 請你,讓我哋去找佢,用某種歡樂使佢被擁抱嘅沉重活躍起嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你,讓我們去找他,用某種歡樂使他被擁抱的沉重活躍起來。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Do we so.
passages.vernacular: 我哋咁樣做吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們這樣做吧。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene IX — Belmont. A Room in Portia’s House 第二幕第九場:貝爾蒙特,鮑西婭家一室

passages.original: Enter Nerissa and a Servitor.
passages.vernacular: [尼莉莎同一名侍者上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [尼莉莎與一名侍者上。]

passages.title: Nerissa 尼莉莎
passages.original: Quick, quick, I pray thee, draw the curtain straight.
passages.vernacular: 快,快,求你,即刻拉開帷幕。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快,快,求你,馬上拉開帷幕。

passages.original: The Prince of Arragon hath ta’en his oath, And comes to his election presently.
passages.vernacular: 阿拉貢親王已宣過誓,即刻嚟作選擇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 阿拉貢親王已宣過誓,馬上來作選擇。

passages.original: Flourish of cornets. Enter the Prince of Arragon, his train, and Portia.
passages.vernacular: [號角齊鳴。阿拉貢親王、佢嘅侍從同鮑西婭上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [號角齊鳴。阿拉貢親王、他的侍從與鮑西婭上。]

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Behold, there stand the caskets, noble Prince, If you choose that wherein I am contain’d, Straight shall our nuptial rites be solemniz’d.
passages.vernacular: 睇,匣子就喺嗰度,高貴嘅親王,如果你選中裝住我嘅嗰個,我哋嘅婚禮即刻舉行。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,匣子就在那裡,高貴的親王,如果你選中裝著我的那個,我們的婚禮馬上舉行。

passages.original: But if you fail, without more speech, my lord, You must be gone from hence immediately.
passages.vernacular: 但如果你失敗,我嘅大人,唔使多講,你必須即刻離開呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但如果你失敗,我的大人,不必多說,你必須立刻離開這裡。

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: I am enjoin’d by oath to observe three things:
passages.vernacular: 我受誓約約束,要遵守三件事:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我受誓約約束,要遵守三件事:

passages.original: First, never to unfold to anyone Which casket ’twas I chose;
passages.vernacular: 第一,永遠不向任何人透露我選嘅係邊個匣子;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 第一,永遠不向任何人透露我選的是哪個匣子;

passages.original: next, if I fail Of the right casket, never in my life To woo a maid in way of marriage;
passages.vernacular: 其次,如果我選不中正確嘅匣子,終生不向任何少女求婚;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 其次,如果我選不中正確的匣子,終生不向任何少女求婚;

passages.original: Lastly, If I do fail in fortune of my choice, Immediately to leave you and be gone.
passages.vernacular: 最後,如果我選擇嘅運氣失敗,即刻離開你,走掉。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最後,如果我選擇的運氣失敗,立刻離開你,走掉。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: To these injunctions everyone doth swear That comes to hazard for my worthless self.
passages.vernacular: 每一個嚟為我呢微不足道嘅人冒險嘅人,都要對呢啲條件發誓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 每一個來為我這微不足道的人冒險的人,都要對這些條件發誓。

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: And so have I address’d me.
passages.vernacular: 我已為此作好準備。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我已為此作好準備。

passages.original: Fortune now To my heart’s hope!
passages.vernacular: 而家願命運成就我心中嘅希望!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在願命運成就我心中的希望!

passages.original: Gold, silver, and base lead.
passages.vernacular: 金、銀同卑賤嘅鉛。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 金、銀和卑賤的鉛。

passages.original: “Who chooseth me must give and hazard all he hath.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下佢一切所有。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者必須付出並冒險拋下他一切所有。」

passages.original: You shall look fairer ere I give or hazard.
passages.vernacular: 喺我付出或冒險之前,你得顯得更漂亮些。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在我付出或冒險之前,你得顯得更漂亮些。

passages.original: What says the golden chest? Ha!
passages.vernacular: 金匣講乜嘢?哈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 金匣說什麼?哈!

passages.original: let me see: “Who chooseth me shall gain what many men desire.”
passages.vernacular: 讓我睇:「選我者將得眾人所欲。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我看:「選我者將得眾人所欲。」

passages.original: What many men desire!
passages.vernacular: 眾人所欲!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 眾人所欲!

passages.original: that “many” may be meant By the fool multitude, that choose by show, Not learning more than the fond eye doth teach, Which pries not to th’ interior, but like the martlet Builds in the weather on the outward wall, Even in the force and road of casualty.
passages.vernacular: 嗰「眾人」可能指嘅係愚蠢嘅大眾,佢哋憑外表選擇,所學不過係癡愚嘅眼睛所教嘅,佢不探究內部,而像燕子一樣把巢築喺外牆上,就喺風雨同意外嘅衝擊之下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那「眾人」可能指的是愚蠢的大眾,他們憑外表選擇,所學不過是癡愚的眼睛所教的,它不探究內部,而像燕子一樣把巢築在外牆上,就在風雨和意外的衝擊之下。

passages.original: I will not choose what many men desire, Because I will not jump with common spirits And rank me with the barbarous multitudes.
passages.vernacular: 我不選眾人所欲嘅,因為我唔願同庸俗嘅精神一致,把自己列入野蠻嘅大眾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我不選眾人所欲的,因為我不願與庸俗的精神一致,把自己列入野蠻的大眾。

passages.original: Why, then to thee, thou silver treasure-house, Tell me once more what title thou dost bear.
passages.vernacular: 咁,對你,你呢銀嘅寶庫,再告訴我一次你帶住乜嘢名號。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼,對你,你這銀的寶庫,再告訴我一次你帶著什麼名號。

passages.original: “Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者將得其所應得。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者將得其所應得。」

passages.original: And well said too; for who shall go about To cozen fortune, and be honourable Without the stamp of merit?
passages.vernacular: 講得都好;因為邊個要去欺騙命運,卻冇功績嘅印記而仍係光榮嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說得也好;因為誰要去欺騙命運,卻沒有功績的印記而仍是光榮的?

passages.original: Let none presume To wear an undeserved dignity.
passages.vernacular: 唔好任何人妄想戴上不配得嘅尊榮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不要任何人妄想戴上不配得的尊榮。

passages.original: O that estates, degrees, and offices Were not deriv’d corruptly, and that clear honour Were purchas’d by the merit of the wearer!
passages.vernacular: 啊,但願地位、爵位同官職唔係以腐敗手段得嚟,清白嘅榮譽係憑佩戴者嘅功績購得!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,但願地位、爵位和官職不是以腐敗手段得來,清白的榮譽是憑佩戴者的功績購得!

passages.original: How many then should cover that stand bare?
passages.vernacular: 嗰時多少站住露頭嘅人該戴上帽子?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那時多少站著露頭的人該戴上帽子?

passages.original: How many be commanded that command?
passages.vernacular: 多少被指揮嘅人該去指揮?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 多少被指揮的人該去指揮?

passages.original: How much low peasantry would then be gleaned From the true seed of honour?
passages.vernacular: 多少低賤嘅農民會從真正榮譽嘅種子中被拾取?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 多少低賤的農民會從真正榮譽的種子中被拾取?

passages.original: And how much honour Pick’d from the chaff and ruin of the times, To be new varnish’d?
passages.vernacular: 又有多少榮譽會從時代嘅糠秕同廢墟中被撿起,重新上漆?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 又有多少榮譽會從時代的糠秕和廢墟中被撿起,重新上漆?

passages.original: Well, but to my choice.
passages.vernacular: 好,講回我嘅選擇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,說回我的選擇。

passages.original: “Who chooseth me shall get as much as he deserves.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者將得其所應得。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者將得其所應得。」

passages.original: I will assume desert.
passages.vernacular: 我就假定自己有功績。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我就假定自己有功績。

passages.original: Give me a key for this, And instantly unlock my fortunes here.
passages.vernacular: 畀我呢個嘅鑰匙,即刻喺呢度打開我嘅命運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給我這個的鑰匙,立刻在這裡打開我的命運。

passages.original: [He opens the silver casket.]
passages.vernacular: [佢打開銀匣。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [他打開銀匣。]

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Too long a pause for that which you find there.
passages.vernacular: 對你喺嗰度找到嘅嘢,停頓得太久喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對你在那裡找到的東西,停頓得太久了。

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: What’s here?
passages.vernacular: 呢度係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡是什麼?

passages.original: The portrait of a blinking idiot Presenting me a schedule!
passages.vernacular: 一個眨眼嘅白癡嘅肖像,畀咗我一張字條!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一個眨眼的白癡的肖像,給了我一張字條!

passages.original: I will read it.
passages.vernacular: 我嚟讀佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我來讀它。

passages.original: How much unlike art thou to Portia!
passages.vernacular: 你同鮑西婭幾咁不同!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你與鮑西婭多麼不同!

passages.original: How much unlike my hopes and my deservings!
passages.vernacular: 同我嘅希望同我嘅應得幾咁不同!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 與我的希望和我的應得多麼不同!

passages.original: “Who chooseth me shall have as much as he deserves.”
passages.vernacular: 「選我者將得其所應得。」
passages.vernacularMandarin: 「選我者將得其所應得。」

passages.original: Did I deserve no more than a fool’s head?
passages.vernacular: 我應得嘅不過係一個傻瓜嘅頭嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我應得的不過是一個傻瓜的頭嗎?

passages.original: Is that my prize?
passages.vernacular: 嗰個就係我嘅獎品?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那就是我的獎品?

passages.original: Are my deserts no better?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅功績不比呢更好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的功績不比這更好嗎?

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: To offend and judge are distinct offices, And of opposed natures.
passages.vernacular: 冒犯同審判係不同嘅職務,而且性質相反。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 冒犯和審判是不同的職務,而且性質相反。

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: What is here?
passages.vernacular: 呢度係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡是什麼?

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: The fire seven times tried this; Seven times tried that judgment is That did never choose amiss.
passages.vernacular: 火七次試煉過呢個;七次試煉嘅係嗰從不選錯嘅判斷。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 火七次試煉過這個;七次試煉的是那從不選錯的判斷。

passages.original: Some there be that shadows kiss; Such have but a shadow’s bliss.
passages.vernacular: 有些人親吻影子;咁樣嘅人只有影子嘅福氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 有些人親吻影子;這樣的人只有影子的福氣。

passages.original: There be fools alive, I wis, Silver’d o’er, and so was this.
passages.vernacular: 世上有活住嘅傻瓜,我想,鍍咗銀,呢個都係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 世上有活著的傻瓜,我想,鍍了銀,這個也是。

passages.original: Take what wife you will to bed, I will ever be your head:
passages.vernacular: 隨你娶乜嘢妻子上床,我永遠係你嘅頭:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 隨你娶什麼妻子上床,我永遠是你的頭:

passages.original: So be gone; you are sped.
passages.vernacular: 所以走吧;你已被打發喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 所以走吧;你已被打發了。

passages.title: Prince of Arragon 阿拉貢親王
passages.original: Still more fool I shall appear By the time I linger here.
passages.vernacular: 我喺呢度逗留嘅時間,只會顯得越嚟越傻。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我在這裡逗留的時間,只會顯得越來越傻。

passages.original: With one fool’s head I came to woo, But I go away with two.
passages.vernacular: 我帶住一個傻瓜嘅頭嚟求婚,卻帶住兩個離開。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我帶著一個傻瓜的頭來求婚,卻帶著兩個離開。

passages.original: Sweet, adieu!
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅,再會!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的,再會!

passages.original: I’ll keep my oath, Patiently to bear my wroth.
passages.vernacular: 我會守我嘅誓言,耐心承受我嘅怒氣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會守我的誓言,耐心承受我的怒氣。

passages.original: [Exit Arragon with his train.]
passages.vernacular: [阿拉貢偕侍從下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [阿拉貢偕侍從下。]

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Thus hath the candle sing’d the moth.
passages.vernacular: 蠟燭就咁樣燒焦咗飛蛾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 蠟燭就這樣燒焦了飛蛾。

passages.original: O, these deliberate fools!
passages.vernacular: 啊,呢啲深思熟慮嘅傻瓜!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,這些深思熟慮的傻瓜!

passages.original: When they do choose, They have the wisdom by their wit to lose.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋選擇時,憑佢哋嘅智慧偏偏會輸。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們選擇時,憑他們的智慧偏偏會輸。

passages.title: Nerissa 尼莉莎
passages.original: The ancient saying is no heresy: Hanging and wiving goes by destiny.
passages.vernacular: 古老嘅講法唔係異端:絞刑同婚姻都由命運註定。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 古老的說法不是異端:絞刑和婚姻都由命運註定。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Come, draw the curtain, Nerissa.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,拉上帷幕,尼莉莎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,拉上帷幕,尼莉莎。

passages.original: Enter a Messenger.
passages.vernacular: [信使上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [信使上。]

passages.title: Messenger 信使
passages.original: Where is my lady?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅小姐喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的小姐在哪裡?

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: Here.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡。

passages.original: What would my lord?
passages.vernacular: 我嘅大人有何吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的大人有何吩咐?

passages.title: Messenger 信使
passages.original: Madam, there is alighted at your gate A young Venetian, one that comes before To signify th’ approaching of his lord, From whom he bringeth sensible regreets;
passages.vernacular: 小姐,您門口嚟咗一位年輕嘅威尼斯人,係先行嚟通報佢主人即將到達嘅,佢帶嚟主人情真意切嘅問候;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 小姐,您門口來了一位年輕的威尼斯人,是先行來通報他主人即將到達的,他帶來主人情真意切的問候;

passages.original: To wit (besides commends and courteous breath) Gifts of rich value;
passages.vernacular: 都就係講(除咗稱讚同客氣嘅話之外)貴重嘅禮物;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 也就是說(除了稱讚和客氣的話之外)貴重的禮物;

passages.original: yet I have not seen So likely an ambassador of love.
passages.vernacular: 我從冇見過咁樣有可能嘅愛嘅使者。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我從沒見過這樣有可能的愛的使者。

passages.original: A day in April never came so sweet, To show how costly summer was at hand, As this fore-spurrer comes before his lord.
passages.vernacular: 四月嘅一天從冇咁樣甜美地嚟,顯示昂貴嘅夏天就喺眼前,就像呢位先驅喺佢主人之前到來。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 四月的一天從沒這樣甜美地來,顯示昂貴的夏天就在眼前,就像這位先驅在他主人之前到來。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: No more, I pray thee.
passages.vernacular: 請你唔好講喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你別說了。

passages.original: I am half afeard Thou wilt say anon he is some kin to thee, Thou spend’st such high-day wit in praising him.
passages.vernacular: 我有點怕你即刻要講佢係你嘅親戚,你咁樣節日般嘅機智嚟讚美佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我有點怕你馬上要說他是你的親戚,你這樣節日般的機智來讚美他。

passages.original: Come, come, Nerissa, for I long to see Quick Cupid’s post that comes so mannerly.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,嚟,尼莉莎,因為我渴望睇睇呢位咁有禮嘅敏捷嘅丘比特嘅使者。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,來,尼莉莎,因為我渴望看看這位那麼有禮的敏捷的丘比特的使者。

passages.title: Nerissa 尼莉莎
passages.original: Bassanio, Lord Love, if thy will it be!
passages.vernacular: 巴薩尼奧,愛神大人,但願如你所願!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 巴薩尼奧,愛神大人,但願如你所願!

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene I — Venice. A Street 第三幕第一場:威尼斯街道

passages.original: Enter Solanio and Salarino.
passages.vernacular: [索拉尼奧同薩萊里諾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [索拉尼奧與薩萊里諾上。]

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Now, what news on the Rialto?
passages.vernacular: 而家,雷雅托有乜嘢消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在,雷雅托有什麼消息?

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Why, yet it lives there unchecked that Antonio hath a ship of rich lading wrack’d on the narrow seas;
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰度仍喺不受制止地流傳,講安東尼奧有一艘滿載貴重貨物嘅船喺窄海上失事喇;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那裡仍在不受制止地流傳,說安東尼奧有一艘滿載貴重貨物的船在窄海上失事了;

passages.original: the Goodwins, I think they call the place, a very dangerous flat and fatal, where the carcasses of many a tall ship lie buried, as they say, if my gossip Report be an honest woman of her word.
passages.vernacular: 我想佢哋叫嗰地方古德溫沙洲,係個好危險致命嘅淺灘,據講許多高大嘅船嘅屍骸埋喺嗰度,如果我嘅八卦朋友「傳聞」係個守信嘅老實女人嘅話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我想他們叫那地方古德溫沙洲,是個非常危險致命的淺灘,據說許多高大的船的屍骸埋在那裡,如果我的八卦朋友「傳聞」是個守信的老實女人的話。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: I would she were as lying a gossip in that as ever knapped ginger or made her neighbours believe she wept for the death of a third husband.
passages.vernacular: 我但願佢喺呢件事上係個講謊嘅八卦婆,像嚼薑餅嘅人或讓鄰居相信佢為第三任丈夫嘅死而哭泣嘅婦人嗰樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我但願她在這件事上是個說謊的八卦婆,像嚼薑餅的人或讓鄰居相信她為第三任丈夫的死而哭泣的婦人那樣。

passages.original: But it is true, without any slips of prolixity or crossing the plain highway of talk, that the good Antonio, the honest Antonio,—O that I had a title good enough to keep his name company!—
passages.vernacular: 但呢個係真嘅,不拖泥帶水,不橫越話語嘅大道,好安東尼奧,誠實嘅安東尼奧,——啊我若有個夠好嘅頭銜嚟配佢嘅名字!——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但這是真的,不拖泥帶水,不橫越話語的大道,好安東尼奧,誠實的安東尼奧,——啊我若有個夠好的頭銜來配他的名字!——

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Come, the full stop.
passages.vernacular: 好喇,句號。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好了,句號。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Ha, what sayest thou?
passages.vernacular: 哈,你講乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈,你說什麼?

passages.original: Why, the end is, he hath lost a ship.
passages.vernacular: 哎,結果係,佢損失咗一艘船。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,結果是,他損失了一艘船。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: I would it might prove the end of his losses.
passages.vernacular: 但願呢個係佢損失嘅終結。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願這是他損失的終結。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Let me say “amen” betimes, lest the devil cross my prayer, for here he comes in the likeness of a Jew.
passages.vernacular: 讓我及早講「阿哋」,免得魔鬼阻撓我嘅祈禱,因為佢以猶太人嘅樣子嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我及早說「阿們」,免得魔鬼阻撓我的祈禱,因為他以猶太人的樣子來了。

passages.original: Enter Shylock.
passages.vernacular: [夏洛克上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [夏洛克上。]

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: How now, Shylock, what news among the merchants?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,夏洛克,商人哋中有乜嘢消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,夏洛克,商人們中有什麼消息?

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: You knew, none so well, none so well as you, of my daughter’s flight.
passages.vernacular: 你知道,邊個都不如你知道得清楚,邊個都不如你,我女兒嘅出走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你知道,誰都不如你知道得清楚,誰都不如你,我女兒的出走。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: That’s certain, I, for my part, knew the tailor that made the wings she flew withal.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係確定嘅,我自己,就認識做佢飛翔所用翅膀嘅裁縫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是確定的,我自己,就認識做她飛翔所用翅膀的裁縫。

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: And Shylock, for his own part, knew the bird was fledged;
passages.vernacular: 而夏洛克,就佢自己而言,知道鳥兒羽翼已豐;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而夏洛克,就他自己而言,知道鳥兒羽翼已豐;

passages.original: and then it is the complexion of them all to leave the dam.
passages.vernacular: 離開母鳥係佢哋全體嘅天性。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 離開母鳥是它們全體的天性。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: She is damn’d for it.
passages.vernacular: 佢為此被詛咒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她為此被詛咒。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: That’s certain, if the devil may be her judge.
passages.vernacular: 嗰個係確定嘅,如果魔鬼能做佢嘅法官。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那是確定的,如果魔鬼能做她的法官。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: My own flesh and blood to rebel!
passages.vernacular: 我自己嘅骨肉竟然反叛!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我自己的骨肉竟然反叛!

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Out upon it, old carrion!
passages.vernacular: 呸,老腐肉!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,老腐肉!

passages.original: Rebels it at these years?
passages.vernacular: 呢個年紀仲反叛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這個年紀還反叛?

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: I say my daughter is my flesh and my blood.
passages.vernacular: 我講我女兒係我嘅骨肉、我嘅血。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我說我女兒是我的骨肉、我的血。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: There is more difference between thy flesh and hers than between jet and ivory, more between your bloods than there is between red wine and Rhenish.
passages.vernacular: 你嘅肉同佢嘅肉之間嘅差別,比黑玉同象牙嘅差別仲大,你哋嘅血之間嘅差別,比紅酒同萊茵白酒嘅差別仲大。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你的肉與她的肉之間的差別,比黑玉與象牙的差別還大,你們的血之間的差別,比紅酒與萊茵白酒的差別還大。

passages.original: But tell us, do you hear whether Antonio have had any loss at sea or no?
passages.vernacular: 但告訴我哋,你聽講安東尼奧喺海上有冇損失?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但告訴我們,你聽說安東尼奧在海上有沒有損失?

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: There I have another bad match, a bankrupt, a prodigal, who dare scarce show his head on the Rialto, a beggar that used to come so smug upon the mart;
passages.vernacular: 又係一樁壞買賣,一個破產者,一個揮霍者,幾乎唔敢喺雷雅托露頭,一個乞丐,以前嚟市場時幾咁體面;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 又是一樁壞買賣,一個破產者,一個揮霍者,幾乎不敢在雷雅托露頭,一個乞丐,以前來市場時多麼體面;

passages.original: let him look to his bond.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢留意佢嘅契約。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他留意他的契約。

passages.original: He was wont to call me usurer; let him look to his bond:
passages.vernacular: 佢以前常叫我放高利貸者;讓佢留意佢嘅契約:
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他以前常叫我放高利貸者;讓他留意他的契約:

passages.original: he was wont to lend money for a Christian cur’sy;
passages.vernacular: 佢以前常出於基督徒嘅客氣借錢;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他以前常出於基督徒的客氣借錢;

passages.original: let him look to his bond.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢留意佢嘅契約。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓他留意他的契約。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: Why, I am sure if he forfeit, thou wilt not take his flesh!
passages.vernacular: 哎,我確信如果佢違約,你唔會攞佢嘅肉!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,我確信如果他違約,你不會拿他的肉!

passages.original: What’s that good for?
passages.vernacular: 嗰有乜嘢用?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那有什麼用?

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: To bait fish withal; if it will feed nothing else, it will feed my revenge.
passages.vernacular: 用嚟釣魚;如果冇別嘅可以餵,至少可以餵我嘅復仇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用來釣魚;如果沒有別的可以餵,至少可以餵我的復仇。

passages.original: He hath disgrac’d me and hind’red me half a million, laugh’d at my losses, mock’d at my gains, scorned my nation, thwarted my bargains, cooled my friends, heated mine enemies.
passages.vernacular: 佢羞辱過我,使我少賺咗五十萬,嘲笑我嘅損失,譏諷我嘅收益,蔑視我嘅民族,阻撓我嘅買賣,使我嘅朋友冷淡,使我嘅敵人憤怒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他羞辱過我,使我少賺了五十萬,嘲笑我的損失,譏諷我的收益,蔑視我的民族,阻撓我的買賣,使我的朋友冷淡,使我的敵人憤怒。

passages.original: And what’s his reason? I am a Jew.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅理由係乜嘢?我係猶太人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的理由是什麼?我是猶太人。

passages.original: Hath not a Jew eyes?
passages.vernacular: 猶太人冇眼睛嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 猶太人沒有眼睛嗎?

passages.original: Hath not a Jew hands, organs, dimensions, senses, affections, passions?
passages.vernacular: 猶太人冇手、器官、身材、感覺、感情、激情嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 猶太人沒有手、器官、身材、感覺、感情、激情嗎?

passages.original: Fed with the same food, hurt with the same weapons, subject to the same diseases, healed by the same means, warmed and cooled by the same winter and summer as a Christian is?
passages.vernacular: 食同樣嘅食物,受同樣嘅武器傷害,患同樣嘅病,用同樣嘅方法醫治,被同樣嘅冬夏冷暖,同基督徒一樣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 吃同樣的食物,受同樣的武器傷害,患同樣的病,用同樣的方法醫治,被同樣的冬夏冷暖,和基督徒一樣嗎?

passages.original: If you prick us, do we not bleed?
passages.vernacular: 你哋刺我哋,我哋不流血嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們刺我們,我們不流血嗎?

passages.original: If you tickle us, do we not laugh?
passages.vernacular: 你哋搔我哋癢,我哋不笑嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們搔我們癢,我們不笑嗎?

passages.original: If you poison us, do we not die?
passages.vernacular: 你哋毒害我哋,我哋不死嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們毒害我們,我們不死嗎?

passages.original: And if you wrong us, shall we not revenge?
passages.vernacular: 你哋冤枉我哋,我哋不報復嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們冤枉我們,我們不報復嗎?

passages.original: If we are like you in the rest, we will resemble you in that.
passages.vernacular: 如果我哋喺其他方面像你哋,我哋就喺呢啲上像你哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果我們在其他方面像你們,我們就在這一點上像你們。

passages.original: If a Jew wrong a Christian, what is his humility? Revenge.
passages.vernacular: 如果猶太人冤枉咗基督徒,佢嘅謙卑係乜嘢?報復。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果猶太人冤枉了基督徒,他的謙卑是什麼?報復。

passages.original: If a Christian wrong a Jew, what should his sufferance be by Christian example?
passages.vernacular: 如果基督徒冤枉咗猶太人,按基督徒嘅榜樣,佢嘅忍耐應該係乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果基督徒冤枉了猶太人,按基督徒的榜樣,他的忍耐應該是什麼?

passages.original: Why, revenge!
passages.vernacular: 哎,報復!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,報復!

passages.original: The villainy you teach me I will execute, and it shall go hard but I will better the instruction.
passages.vernacular: 你哋教我嘅惡行,我會執行,而且我一定會超越呢教導。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們教我的惡行,我會執行,而且我一定會超越這教導。

passages.original: Enter a man from Antonio.
passages.vernacular: [安東尼奧家嘅一個人上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [安東尼奧家的一個人上。]

passages.title: Servant 僕人
passages.original: Gentlemen, my master Antonio is at his house, and desires to speak with you both.
passages.vernacular: 先生哋,我嘅主人安東尼奧喺佢家裡,想同你哋兩位講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生們,我的主人安東尼奧在他家裡,想和你們兩位說話。

passages.title: Salarino 薩萊里諾
passages.original: We have been up and down to seek him.
passages.vernacular: 我哋到處找佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們到處找他。

passages.original: Enter Tubal.
passages.vernacular: [圖巴爾上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [圖巴爾上。]

passages.title: Solanio 索拉尼奧
passages.original: Here comes another of the tribe; a third cannot be match’d, unless the devil himself turn Jew.
passages.vernacular: 又嚟咗一個同族;第三個係找唔到相配嘅喇,除非魔鬼自己變成猶太人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 又來了一個同族;第三個是找不到相配的了,除非魔鬼自己變成猶太人。

passages.original: [Exeunt Solanio, Salarino and the Servant.]
passages.vernacular: [索拉尼奧、薩萊里諾同僕人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [索拉尼奧、薩萊里諾與僕人下。]

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: How now, Tubal, what news from Genoa?
passages.vernacular: 點喇,圖巴爾,熱嗰亞有乜嘢消息?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,圖巴爾,熱那亞有什麼消息?

passages.original: Hast thou found my daughter?
passages.vernacular: 你找到我女兒咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你找到我女兒了嗎?

passages.title: Tubal 圖巴爾
passages.original: I often came where I did hear of her, but cannot find her.
passages.vernacular: 我常到聽講佢喺嘅地方,卻找唔到佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我常到聽說她在的地方,卻找不到她。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: Why there, there, there, there!
passages.vernacular: 哎,嗰度,嗰度,嗰度,嗰度!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,那裡,那裡,那裡,那裡!

passages.original: A diamond gone cost me two thousand ducats in Frankfort!
passages.vernacular: 一顆走失嘅鑽石,喺法蘭克福花咗我兩千杜卡特!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一顆走失的鑽石,在法蘭克福花了我兩千杜卡特!

passages.original: The curse never fell upon our nation till now, I never felt it till now.
passages.vernacular: 詛咒直到而家才降喺我哋民族身上,我直到而家才感受到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 詛咒直到現在才降在我們民族身上,我直到現在才感受到。

passages.original: Two thousand ducats in that, and other precious, precious jewels.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰度面兩千杜卡特,仲有其他珍貴嘅、珍貴嘅珠寶。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那裡面兩千杜卡特,還有其他珍貴的、珍貴的珠寶。

passages.original: I would my daughter were dead at my foot, and the jewels in her ear;
passages.vernacular: 我但願我女兒死喺我腳邊,珠寶喺佢耳朵上;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我但願我女兒死在我腳邊,珠寶在她耳朵上;

passages.original: would she were hearsed at my foot, and the ducats in her coffin.
passages.vernacular: 但願佢被放喺靈車上停喺我腳邊,杜卡特喺佢棺材裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但願她被放在靈車上停在我腳邊,杜卡特在她棺材裡。

passages.original: No news of them? Why so?
passages.vernacular: 冇佢哋嘅消息嗎?哎,點會?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有他們的消息嗎?哎,怎麼會?

passages.original: And I know not what’s spent in the search.
passages.vernacular: 而且我唔知道搜尋花費咗多少。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 而且我不知道搜尋花費了多少。

passages.original: Why, thou—loss upon loss!
passages.vernacular: 哎,你——損失接住損失!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,你——損失接著損失!

passages.original: The thief gone with so much, and so much to find the thief, and no satisfaction, no revenge, nor no ill luck stirring but what lights o’ my shoulders, no sighs but o’ my breathing, no tears but o’ my shedding.
passages.vernacular: 賊帶走咁多,又花咁多去找賊,既無滿足,又無報復,除咗落喺我肩上嘅,冇惡運喺動,除咗我自己嘅呼吸冇嘆息,除咗我自己流嘅冇眼淚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 賊帶走這麼多,又花這麼多去找賊,既無滿足,又無報復,除了落在我肩上的,沒有惡運在動,除了我自己的呼吸沒有嘆息,除了我自己流的沒有眼淚。

passages.title: Tubal 圖巴爾
passages.original: Yes, other men have ill luck too.
passages.vernacular: 對,別人都有惡運。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,別人也有惡運。

passages.original: Antonio, as I heard in Genoa—
passages.vernacular: 安東尼奧,我喺熱嗰亞聽講——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安東尼奧,我在熱那亞聽說——

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: What, what, what?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,乜嘢,乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,什麼,什麼?

passages.original: Ill luck, ill luck?
passages.vernacular: 惡運,惡運?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 惡運,惡運?

passages.title: Tubal 圖巴爾
passages.original: —hath an argosy cast away coming from Tripolis.
passages.vernacular: ——有一艘大商船從嘅黎波里嚟時沉沒喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: ——有一艘大商船從的黎波里來時沉沒了。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: I thank God!
passages.vernacular: 我感謝上帝!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我感謝上帝!

passages.original: I thank God!
passages.vernacular: 我感謝上帝!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我感謝上帝!

passages.original: Is it true, is it true?
passages.vernacular: 係真嘅嗎,係真嘅嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是真的嗎,是真的嗎?

passages.title: Tubal 圖巴爾
passages.original: I spoke with some of the sailors that escaped the wrack.
passages.vernacular: 我跟啲逃過失事嘅水手談過。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我跟一些逃過失事的水手談過。

passages.title: Shylock 夏洛克
passages.original: I thank thee, good Tubal.
passages.vernacular: 我感謝你,好圖巴爾。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我感謝你,好圖巴爾。

passages.original: Good news, good news!
passages.vernacular: 好消息,好消息!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好消息,好消息!

passages.original: Ha, ha, heard in Genoa?
passages.vernacular: 哈,哈,喺熱嗰亞聽講嘅?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈,哈,在熱那亞聽說的?

passages.title: Tubal 圖巴爾
