passages.vernacular: 你哋會發現鮑西婭就係博士,尼莉莎就係佢嘅書記。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們會發現鮑西婭就是博士,尼莉莎就是她的書記。

passages.original: Lorenzo here Shall witness I set forth as soon as you, And even but now return’d.
passages.vernacular: 呢度嘅羅倫佐可以作證,我同你哋同時出發,剛頭先回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡的羅倫佐可以作證,我和你們同時出發,剛剛才回來。

passages.original: I have not yet Enter’d my house.
passages.vernacular: 我仲冇進過我嘅房子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我還沒進過我的房子。

passages.original: Antonio, you are welcome, And I have better news in store for you Than you expect: unseal this letter soon.
passages.vernacular: 安東尼奧,歡迎你,我為你儲備咗比你期望更好嘅消息:快拆開呢封信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 安東尼奧,歡迎你,我為你儲備了比你期望更好的消息:快拆開這封信。

passages.original: There you shall find three of your argosies Are richly come to harbour suddenly.
passages.vernacular: 喺嗰度你會發現你有三艘大商船突然滿載而富裕地到港喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在那裡你會發現你有三艘大商船突然滿載而富裕地到港了。

passages.original: You shall not know by what strange accident I chanced on this letter.
passages.vernacular: 你唔會知道我係憑乜嘢奇怪嘅機緣得到呢封信。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不會知道我是憑什麼奇怪的機緣得到這封信。

passages.title: Antonio 安東尼奧
passages.original: I am dumb.
passages.vernacular: 我啞口無言。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我啞口無言。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Were you the doctor, and I knew you not?
passages.vernacular: 你係博士,我竟不認得你?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是博士,我竟不認得你?

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Were you the clerk that is to make me cuckold?
passages.vernacular: 你係嗰個要使我戴綠帽嘅書記嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是那個要使我戴綠帽的書記嗎?

passages.title: Nerissa 尼莉莎
passages.original: Ay, but the clerk that never means to do it, Unless he live until he be a man.
passages.vernacular: 對,但呢個書記永遠不打算咁樣做,除非佢活到成為男人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,但這個書記永遠不打算這樣做,除非他活到成為男人。

passages.title: Bassanio 巴薩尼奧
passages.original: Sweet doctor, you shall be my bedfellow.
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅博士,你將做我嘅床伴。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的博士,你將做我的床伴。

passages.original: When I am absent, then lie with my wife.
passages.vernacular: 當我不喺時,就同我妻子同瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 當我不在時,就和我妻子同睡。

passages.title: Antonio 安東尼奧
passages.original: Sweet lady, you have given me life and living;
passages.vernacular: 親愛嘅夫人,你畀咗我生命同生計;
passages.vernacularMandarin: 親愛的夫人,你給了我生命和生計;

passages.original: For here I read for certain that my ships Are safely come to road.
passages.vernacular: 因為我喺呢度確實讀到,我嘅船都安全到港喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 因為我在這裡確實讀到,我的船都安全到港了。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: How now, Lorenzo!
passages.vernacular: 點喇,羅倫佐!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,羅倫佐!

passages.original: My clerk hath some good comforts too for you.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅書記都有些好安慰要畀你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的書記也有些好安慰要給你。

passages.title: Nerissa 尼莉莎
passages.original: Ay, and I’ll give them him without a fee.
passages.vernacular: 對,我會不收費地畀佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,我會不收費地給他。

passages.original: There do I give to you and Jessica, From the rich Jew, a special deed of gift, After his death, of all he dies possess’d of.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度我畀你同潔西卡,從嗰富有嘅猶太人嗰度嚟嘅一份特別贈同契約,喺佢死後,佢所擁有嘅一切都歸你哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡我給你和潔西卡,從那富有的猶太人那裡來的一份特別贈與契約,在他死後,他所擁有的一切都歸你們。

passages.title: Lorenzo 羅倫佐
passages.original: Fair ladies, you drop manna in the way Of starved people.
passages.vernacular: 美麗嘅夫人哋,你哋把嗎邊灑喺飢餓嘅人嘅路上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 美麗的夫人們,你們把嗎哪灑在飢餓的人的路上。

passages.title: Portia 鮑西婭
passages.original: It is almost morning, And yet I am sure you are not satisfied Of these events at full.
passages.vernacular: 天快亮喇,不過我確信你哋對呢啲事件仲冇完全弄清楚。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 天快亮了,可是我確信你們對這些事件還沒有完全弄清楚。

passages.original: Let us go in, And charge us there upon inter’gatories, And we will answer all things faithfully.
passages.vernacular: 我哋進去,喺嗰度對我哋進行審問,我哋會忠實地回答一切。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們進去,在那裡對我們進行審問,我們會忠實地回答一切。

passages.title: Gratiano 葛拉蒂安諾
passages.original: Let it be so.
passages.vernacular: 就咁樣吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 就這樣吧。

passages.original: The first inter’gatory That my Nerissa shall be sworn on is, Whether till the next night she had rather stay, Or go to bed now, being two hours to day.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅尼莉莎要宣誓回答嘅第一個問題係,佢寧願等到下一個夜晚,定係而家就上床,離天亮仲有兩小時。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的尼莉莎要宣誓回答的第一個問題是,她寧願等到下一個夜晚,還是現在就上床,離天亮還有兩小時。

passages.original: But were the day come, I should wish it dark Till I were couching with the doctor’s clerk.
passages.vernacular: 但如果天亮喇,我會希望佢黑住,直到我同博士嘅書記同眠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但如果天亮了,我會希望它黑著,直到我與博士的書記同眠。

passages.original: Well, while I live, I’ll fear no other thing So sore as keeping safe Nerissa’s ring.
passages.vernacular: 好,只要我活住,我最怕嘅就係保不住尼莉莎嘅戒指。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,只要我活著,我最怕的就是保不住尼莉莎的戒指。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]
